question: What arises when the garland of letters is embraced by reflective I-awareness?
premises: The phonemic unfolding is embraced in the awareness 'I'.
This awareness has the nature of reflective self-consciousness.
From that arises the vivid flash of full supreme I-consciousness.
inference: When the power of action is gathered into reflective I-awareness, it manifests as the full supreme I-consciousness.
plain_english: Embraced in the reflective awareness 'I', it abides there; from that arises the vivid flash of the full, supreme I-consciousness.
